purpose: First-pass SME review queue for high-consequence Journeyman lesson material. This queue is an editorial control; it does not certify code accuracy or state-exam alignment.
release_rule: Every required artifact must be approved by a qualified reviewer before a lesson may be represented as SME-approved or state-exam aligned.
